description: Combine FII/DII flow trend, market regime, breadth, and index evidence to explain market risk-on or risk-off context. Variant focus: deep institutional review; timeframe: last 20 sessions; response style: ranked candidates.
input_patterns: market regime with FII DII and breadth
is the market risk on based on flows and breadth

review.rationale: Static audit and test findings drive deterministic review.

sql_templates.main_query:
WITH latest_sessions AS (
    SELECT trade_date
    FROM signals.fii_dii_flows
    ORDER BY trade_date DESC
    LIMIT 20
),
joined_data AS (
    SELECT f.trade_date, f.fii_net_5d, f.dii_net_5d, r.regime, r.confidence, b.ad_oscillator,
           b.trin, i.index_symbol, i.trend_signal
    FROM signals.fii_dii_flows f
    JOIN signals.regime_history r ON f.trade_date = r.trade_date
    JOIN breadth.market_daily b ON f.trade_date = b.trade_date
    JOIN market.index_eod i ON f.trade_date = i.trade_date
    WHERE f.trade_date IN (SELECT trade_date FROM latest_sessions)
      AND i.index_symbol = 'Nifty 50'
)
SELECT *
FROM joined_data
ORDER BY trade_date;

synthesis_guidance: Generate insights based on the combined data for the last 20 sessions. Identify regime, flows, breadth, and index signals indicating risk-on or risk-off context.
title: FII DII Regime Breadth Review Variant 0232
